cells.reason: None of the provided San Francisco documents describe a local application or screening fee ordinance. The Rent Board pages cover rent increases, security deposit interest, relocation and just cause, and none of them mention screening fees. The state cap in Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.6 governs application screening fees for SF units. I did not confirm that SF has no local rule beyond the provided documents.
cells.quoted_span: In no case shall the amount of the application screening fee charged by the landlord or their agent be greater than thirty dollars ($30) per applicant.
